import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class A {
    private static List<Long> list, subsets;

    private static void generateSubsets(int index, long currentSum) {
        if (index == list.size()) {
            subsets.add(currentSum);
            return;
        }
        generateSubsets(index + 1, currentSum + list.get(index));
        generateSubsets(index + 1, currentSum);
    }

    private static boolean verify(long M, long W, long x) {
        if (x == M) return true;

        long tempX = x + M;
        while (tempX > 0) {
            if (tempX % W > 1) {
                return false;
            }
            tempX /= W;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] input = reader.readLine().trim().split(" ");
        long W = Long.parseLong(input[0]);
        long M = Long.parseLong(input[1]);

        if (W == 2) {
            System.out.println("YES");
            return;
        }

        list = new ArrayList<>();
        list.add(1L);
        list.add(W);

        long current = W;
        final long MAX_LIMIT = (long) 1e10;

        while (true) {
            current *= W;
            if (current < 0 || current > MAX_LIMIT) break;
            list.add(current);
        }

        subsets = new ArrayList<>();
        generateSubsets(0, 0);

        boolean result = false;
        for (long x : subsets) {
            result |= verify(M, W, x);
            if (result) break;
        }

        System.out.println(result ? "YES" : "NO");
    }
}
